title: Use parallel lookup for specific paper requests
description: Changes specific-paper retrieval from lookup-first to parallel academic lookup plus native websearch/webfetch verification.
changes: Clarify that arc_lookup_paper collects academic-library candidates rather than complete web evidence.
Require first-round parallel lookup with arc_lookup_paper and native websearch for concrete paper names, acronyms, approximate titles, and versioned names.
Require webfetch verification for arXiv, OpenReview, ACL, PMLR, DOI, or official paper/project pages found via websearch.
Do not ask the user merely because arc_lookup_paper returns needs_confirmation=true; inspect web evidence first.
Reject candidates that only match versions, years, numbers, or generic words.

rollback.notes: Restore lookup-first routing if native websearch causes unacceptable latency or noise.
